title: Define orphaned adopted-trace and historical outbox behavior on reset or project detachment
outcome: Document and test the disposition of an adopted trace that has no observed terminal boundary, and of retained closing jobs/reports when Engram settings reset or the project is detached; avoid silently overwriting an orphan trace.
acceptance: An adopted trace left without an owned terminal boundary is explicitly retained or settled with a visible unreported reason when a later adoption or restart encounters it; the policy is documented and tested.

Settings reset and project detachment tests establish whether historical immutable reports continue delivery through their original connection and whether closing jobs settle visibly on scope loss; no report is re-scoped to another claim.
The maintained full gate passes on the exact input.
